title: The inference domain shows its calls on the command line
intention: cairn inference_domain show calls --limit 20 prints the stored inference calls one per line for Akien, and get calls returns them as JSON for Claude, bounded by limit and since.
why: Akien 2026-10-13: "cairn's intention is to be the command line access to the bus" and "it would be: cairn inference_domain show/get calls --limit 20 --- show for me (formatted), get for you (json)". Measured 2026-10-13: the calls are reachable only as the bus verb 'calls' (b905340f8162, device.py _handle_calls); declared_views is yield and models only, so `cairn inference_domain show calls` answers 'no view'.
traces_to: The cairn command's intention as Akien stated it 2026-10-13 (the command line access to the bus) and Law 1 (the domain's stored calls are readable by both operators without a script).
how: cairn/devices/inference_domain only; builds after the view-arguments ticket in cairn/tools/base is PROVED. (a) declared_views adds 'calls': self._calls_view, def _calls_view(self, limit=None, since=None) -> dict returning self._handle_calls({'body': {'limit': limit, 'since': since}}) (so limit defaults to 100 and caps at 1000 exactly as the verb). (b) _render_view override: for 'calls', one line per row: created (to the second), verdict, cost, and canonical cut to 80 chars, newest first, then a last line 'N calls'; other views fall through to super(). The bus verb 'calls' stays (the librarian's ingest uses it, 95f8c561e742).
falsifier: cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_the_calls_are_a_view.py under PROVES {'f09c594cf6d8': {'1','2','3'}}, domain.read_ticket monkeypatched to record its kwargs and return two rows: (1) 'calls' is in InferenceDomainDevice().declared_views(); (2) _calls_view(limit='2', since='2026-10-01T00:00:00') calls read_ticket with limit=2 and that since, and returns {'calls': [...]} that json.dumps accepts; (3) _render_view('calls', data) has one line per row carrying its verdict and its created second, and ends with '2 calls'. Hollow: today's device.py reds 1-3.
watchme: none, because the fault is measured at /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py and the proof's teeth are its falsifier
intent_berth: none, because Akien specified it in conversation 2026-10-13, his words recorded verbatim at /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/ideas/2026-10-13-so-lets-talk-first-about-the-cairn.json and quoted in why

decisions.text: The view delegates to _handle_calls so the verb and the view cannot disagree on bounds. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12
